title: P ZERO Race TLR 4S
notes: Official tech specs read 2026-11-01: 28-622 320 g, 30-622 365 g, 32-622 410 g; 120 TPI SpeedCORE. Page: first year-long racing tyre with tubeless technology giving high grip in all kinds of weather; SmartNET Silica compound described as Pirelli's best formulation for wet and chemical grip; made in Italy at the Bollate factory. No hookless statement or maximum pressure.
